description: Re-check up to 20 semantic links (`link` notes) by `noteId` and `version`, and get each one's verification back (`null` for a note that is not a link). The platform re-checks doubtful links (`unchecked` with `refs_pending`) by itself when the Host is idle, so you normally do not call this. Call it only when you are about to act on a doubtful link right now and need the result first. It is much slower than a read, usually a few seconds; the first call after the Host starts may reach the time limit, and then this call answers `unchecked` (`budget`) and the platform finishes the check later. It writes nothing.
